name: spikes-faint-at-turn-end
why: The opponent's Pokemon faints from poison at the end of a turn and its replacement (2 HP left) faints from the player's Spikes as it comes in. The game then forgets the PLAYER's last move (gLastMoves[0] = 0xFFFF), not the opponent's (docs/parity-mac/end-turn-attacker.md).
